Revised Guidelines for Incentive to Full time Ph.D Scholars belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Caste Converted Christians and Scheduled Tribes students

1. Background

The scheme of providing incentives to the full time Ph.D scholars for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste Converted Christians was introduced during the year 2013-14. The scheme aims to provide opportunities to these students to undertake advanced studies and research in the fields of Science, Humanities, Social Science, Commerce and Law streams.

2. Objective

The objective of the scheme is to provide opportunities to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste Converted Christians students to undertake full time Ph.D research courses in the fields of Science, Humanities, Social Science, Commerce and Law streams in State Universities / Government / Government Aided Colleges in Tamil Nadu.

3. Target / Eligibility:

Target Group: The scheme provides incentives for 1600 eligible Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Caste Converted Christians and Scheduled Tribes applicants including renewal cases every year to undertake advanced studies and research leading to Ph.D Degree.

Eligibility:

I. Income limit: Family income shall be less than Rs.8 lakhs per annum

ll. Caste: Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste Converted Christians.

lll. Age: Age limit for male applicants is 50 years on the date of receipt of applications and age limit for female applicants is 55 years on the date of receipt of applications.

IV. Educational Qualification:

a) A minimum of 55% of marks in the aggregate in the qualifying master degree examination.

b) The Scholar should not receive any other monetary benefits / Scholarship / Fellowship from any other source.

c) Employees of any university / College / Educational Institutions / Central/ State / UT Government shall be excluded ‘from availing fellowship, even if they are on study leave or extra ordinary leave.

4. Nature of Assistance

a) Tenure will be 2-4 years for the students who completed M.Phil and 3-5 years for the students who completed Master Degree depending upon the course in Ph.D

b) Incentive of Rs.1,00,000/- would be provided to the beneficiaries in 10 monthly installments. (Rs.10,000 / month) by Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.

c) 5% grant shall be reserved for differently abled students.

a) Applications should be invited only through online mode in the prescribed format through advertisement in leading newspapers / Adi Dravidar Welfare Department Website / Circular to all the colleges, Universities through Higher Education Department.

The Hon’ble Minister for Finance and Human Resources Management on the floor of the Legislative Assembly on 19th February 2024 in the Budget Speech (2024-2025), made the following announcement:

“As the State with the highest contribution to the number of women working in industries in India and_ with significant gender parity in its labour ecosystem, Tamil Nadu is a favoured destination for progressive investors. Well aware of these advantages, the Government will introduce a special scheme _ to incentivize additional women employment in the State. This scheme will offer a payroll subsidy of 10 per cent of the salary of women, differently abled and transgender employees for two years to all new industrial units providing direct employment to over 500 such individuals from Tamil Nadu.”

2. The Government after careful examination, hereby formulate the ‘Special Scheme to incentivize employment of women, differently abled and transgender persons in Tamil Nadu’ wherein a payroll subsidy of 10 per cent of the payroll cost of employees who are women, differently abled and transgendered shall be provided for two years to new manufacturing projects in the State, subject to the following conditions :

i. The eligible industrial unit shall be engaged in manufacturing activity within the State.

ii. The eligible unit shall create minimum new direct employment for 500 eligible persons within the Scheme Period.

iii. The eligible employees must be domiciles of Tamil Nadu.

iv. Eligible differently abled employees must be those with benchmarked disabilities.

v. The eligible unit shall commence operations within the Scheme Period.

vi. Eligible unit should not have availed a structured package of assistance under the Tamil Nadu Policy, 2021.

vii. Payroll Cost shall be defined as the “basic wages” received by the employees as defined in Section 2(b) of the Employees Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952.

viii. The Payroll Subsidy shall exclude the payment to the key managerial personne! and the members of the Board of Directors.
